actions.agent-add-rag.props.rag_id.descr: The ID of the RAG to add to the agent

actions.agent_prompt_completion.descript: Prompt an agent with a message and get a response

actions.agent_prompt_completion.props.la: Diversity of results returned by MMR (0 for minimum, 1 for maximum)

New custom prompt for the agent

actions.agent_update.props.visibility.de: New visibility setting for the agent

Represents the chunking method to be used for generating the RAG base. The default value is fixed_size
actions.create_rag.props.description.des: Represents the description of the agent

actions.create_rag.props.name.descriptio: Represents the name of the RAG base

actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_rag.description: Delete a specific RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) base by its ID.
actions.delete_rag.props.ragId.descripti: The ID of the RAG base to delete
actions.file_upload.description: Upload a file to Straico API for processing.
actions.file_upload.props.file.descripti: The file to upload. Supported file types: pdf, docx, pptx, txt, xlsx, mp3, mp4, html, csv, json, py, php, js, css, cs, swift, kt, xml, ts, png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif
actions.get_rag_by_id.description: Retrieve a specific RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) base by its ID.
actions.get_rag_by_id.props.ragId.descri: The ID of the RAG base to retrieve.
actions.image_generation.description: Enables users to generate high-quality images based on textual descriptions.
actions.image_generation.props.descripti: A detailed textual description of the image to be generated.
actions.list_rags.description: List all RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) bases for a user.
actions.prompt_completion.description: Enables users to generate prompt completion based on a specified model.
actions.prompt_completion.props.displayT: If true, returns transcripts of the files. Note: Either File URLs or YouTube URLs are required when this is enabled
actions.prompt_completion.props.fileUrls: URLs of files to be processed by the model (maximum 4 URLs), previously uploaded via the File Upload endpoint
actions.prompt_completion.props.imageUrl: URLs of images to be processed by the model, previously uploaded via the File Upload endpoint
actions.prompt_completion.props.maxToken: Set the limit for the number of tokens the model can generate in response
actions.prompt_completion.props.model.de: The model which will generate the completion. Some models are suitable for natural language tasks, others specialize in code.
actions.prompt_completion.props.prompt.d: The prompt text for which completions are requested
actions.prompt_completion.props.temperat: This setting influences the variety in the model's responses (0-2)
actions.prompt_completion.props.youtubeU: URLs of YouTube videos to be processed by the model (maximum 4 URLs)
actions.rag_prompt_completion.descriptio: Send a prompt to a specific RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) model.
actions.rag_prompt_completion.props.fetc: Amount of documents to pass to MMR algorithm
actions.rag_prompt_completion.props.lamb: Diversity of results return by MMR (1 for minimum and 0 for maximum)
actions.rag_prompt_completion.props.mode: The specific LLM to be used
actions.rag_prompt_completion.props.prom: A text prompt for the RAG model
actions.rag_prompt_completion.props.ragI: The ID of the RAG base to query

actions.update_rag.props.ragId.descripti: The ID of the RAG base to update.
auth.description:
Follow these instructions to get your Straico API Key:

1. Visit the following website: https://platform.straico.com/user-settings.
2. Once on the website, locate "Connect with Straico API" and click on the copy API Key.
